summary_en: Fiscal 2027 dividend per share raised by 2 yen to 38 yen from 36 yen, with consolidated payout ratio of 30.1%, reflecting improved earnings and reduction in dividend-paying shares from share buybacks.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Business Performance Forecast and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ended March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Daido Signal revised its dividend forecast for fiscal 2027 ended March 31, 2027, raising the year-end dividend per share by 2 yen to 38 yen from the previously forecast 36 yen. The company maintained its interim dividend at zero yen, making the total annual dividend 38 yen per share. This revision reflects improved business performance driven by sustained recovery in capital investment among major railway operators, coupled with limited impact from geopolitical risks and raw material price increases in the first half of the fiscal year. The company also reduced the number of dividend-paying shares through share buybacks executed during the period.

The company operates under a dividend policy targeting a stable and continuous payout based on consolidated results, growth investments, and financial soundness, with a target consolidated dividend payout ratio of 30% or higher. With this increase, the anticipated consolidated payout ratio for fiscal 2027 is 30.1%. The company stated that its policy on reducing policy-held securities remains unchanged as it continues efforts to improve capital efficiency.
